events.description: PPDI incorporated in Newfoundland and Labrador
PPDI acquires the Holyrood Property, which then needs undisclosed repairs
events.quote: In December 2024, PPDI acquired the Holyrood Property.

events.description: Department of Education says the Holyrood expansion will not be approved
events.quote: In June 2025, after meeting with the Department of Education and Government Service Centre representatives

events.description: Payments of about $26,678.52 received on CRA arrears
CRA statement shows source deduction arrears of $642,362.29
events.quote: The CRA's statement of account dated January 20, 2026 shows a current arrears balance of $642,362.29.

events.description: Account manager advises PPDI its accounts moved to RBC Special Loans Group
events.quote: On or about 02 March 2026, PPDI was advised by its account manager that its accounts had been transferred to RBC's Special Loans Group.

events.description: PPDI raises cash flow concerns with the Department of Education
events.quote: In the first week of March 2026, we raised cash flow concerns with the Department of Education

events.description: Joel Robbins of RBC emails asking for a call with ownership; unanswered
events.quote: On 03 March and 09 March 2026, Joel Robbins, Senior Manager, Special Loans and Advisory Services, sent emails to PPDI requesting a call with ownership.

events.description: RBC writes that it will exit the relationship and issue demands
events.quote: On 10 March 2026, Mr. Robbins wrote to PPDI advising that

events.description: RBC issues section 244 demands for $2,532,123.48 with forbearance to April 30
events.quote: On 20 March 2026, RBC issued demands pursuant to section 244 of the BIA in respect of PPDl's loaned facilities.

events.description: Department of Education agrees to license 30 additional Holyrood spaces (not OGP-funded)
events.quote: On 23 March 2026, the Department of Education agreed to license the 30 additional Holyrood spaces.

events.description: Company counsel requests a tolling agreement from RBC
events.quote: On 23 March 2026, Company counsel requested a tolling agreement

events.description: RBC (Spencer) confirms willingness to enter forbearance but not suspend the demand period
events.quote: On 24 March 2026, Mr. Spencer confirmed that RBC remained willing to enter into the proposed Forbearance Agreement

events.description: RBC's final position: forbear to April 30 but no suspension of the demand period
events.quote: On 27 March 2026, Mr. Spencer confirmed RBC's final position

events.description: PPDI files its NOI and obtains a stay to April 26, 2026
events.quote: On 27 March 2026, PPDI filed a NOi and was granted a stay of proceedings up to 26 April 2026.

events.description: PPDI enters DIP term sheet with Libra Finance
events.quote: the Company has negotiated and entered into terms with Libra Finance Company Inc.

events.description: Cash flow forecast prepared by the Company and Proposal Trustee
events.quote: The Cashflow Forecast was prepared by the Company and the Proposal Trustee.

events.description: Payroll due that the DIP loan must fund
